description: This header file defines the declaration of the NativeJSImplementation class, which implements the INativeJS interface for a plugin system. It includes method declarations for initializing, creating applications, running applications and JavaScript code, and termination, along with member variables related to threading and rendering.

classes.name: NativeJSImplementation
classes.description: A class implementing the INativeJS interface for managing native JavaScript applications within the plugin, including lifecycle and execution control.

methods.name: NativeJSImplementation
methods.description: Constructor for initializing an instance of NativeJSImplementation.

methods.name: ~NativeJSImplementation
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up resources used by the instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the native JS environment with the specified display.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes and cleans up the native JS environment.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new application with given options, returning its identifier.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves the list or details of existing applications.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs the application identified by the given ID with specified URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes the provided JavaScript code within the specified application.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates the application with the specified ID.
